purpose: Stress-test the canonical material-grade model against large commercial engineering-plastics catalogues without publishing unverified grade claims.
notes: This umbrella manifest tracks pilot progress without duplicating exact-grade records; gradeRecords intentionally remains empty here.
LOTTE pilot progress points to the separately validated lotte-exact-grade-pilot-v1 dataset and the published runtime catalog.
LG Chem pilot progress points to the separately validated lg-chem-exact-grade-pilot-v1 dataset; exact-grade claims come only from current LG Chem/LG Chem On primary TDS records.

KEPITAL pilot progress points to the separately validated kepital-exact-grade-pilot-v1 dataset. The stable mfr-kep identifier is retained while the current primary brand-owner source is identified as Korea Polyacetal (KPAC), which states that it sustains the KEPITAL brand.
KEPITAL melt-flow values remain omitted because the reviewed current KPAC exact-grade sheets do not expose the temperature/load required for engineering comparison.
KOLON ENP remains a discovery target until primary-source exact-grade records pass the same staging and semantic gates.
Acquired source documents should be fingerprinted before extraction where redistribution/rights permit local retention.
Every extracted observation must reference a sourceId and retain its test conditions rather than collapsing datasheet tables into generic values.
